title: Archive one Project without changing identity or deleting history

requirements.invariant: Archive targets one stable ProjectID and carries no Client identity mutation, copied Client name or reassignment input; the Project's authoritative Client relationship remains unchanged.

ArchiveProject is a distinct history-preserving lifecycle intent. It cannot physically delete the Project, orphan children/accounting evidence, rename/edit/reassign it or impersonate a future delete decision; O-024 remains open.

ArchiveProject expresses one business intent through typed Ledger values and exposes no arbitrary field map, collection/path/SQL string, generic CRUD, delete flag, lifecycle toggle, Client/category/media/accounting mutation or backend SDK type.

The Project archive payload is bound to exactly one OperationID, contract version, AccountID, actor PrincipalID and finite client-created time through the shared operation fingerprint and receipt lifecycle; archive defines no competing queue, retry, result or rejection semantics.

Archive carries exactly one expected-revision precondition for the same Project subject so stale intent cannot silently become last-write-wins; local construction records the precondition but does not decide authoritative conflict or idempotent-already-applied results.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One narrow backend-neutral Project archive operation accepts the validated command and returns the shared OperationReceipt or a stable failure; local validation never substitutes for trusted membership, Project existence/revision or archive authorization at the later server boundary.

This Phase 1 command boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped app remains unchanged and no Project table/handler, RLS, Sync Stream, Auth/provider choice, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: ExpectedProjectRevision is a typed UInt64 value used only to derive the exact expectedRevision precondition for the same stable Project subject.

ProjectArchiveDraft owns exact Account, actor, operation-contract, stable Project, expected revision and finite capture time; it contains no Client/name/description/category/media/child/accounting/delete/restore input.

ArchiveProjectPayload contains only ProjectID. ArchiveProjectCommand binds it to the shared OperationEnvelope, derives the exact Project subject and fingerprint, requires exactly its derived expected-revision precondition and revalidates all duplicated evidence on decode.

ProjectArchiving is the narrow backend-neutral operation port returning the shared OperationReceipt; command receipt validation requires the exact OperationID and exposes no authoritative archived-row/result claim.

ProjectArchiveFailure exposes stable bounded time, binding, precondition, subject, fingerprint, receipt, local-acceptance and malformed-encoding codes while reusing shared typed identifier and operation validators.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 contract creates no projects table, lifecycle/revision/audit column, foreign key, check, index, view, tombstone or migration.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No authoritative ArchiveProject handler, membership/Project lookup, revision lock, archive idempotency storage, child/history preservation transaction, audit timestamp, conflict result or server update exists.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API and no grant is added.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Typed Account/actor/Project binding is not authorization. No membership predicate, grant, WITH CHECK policy or cross-tenant database test exists.

syncStreams.notApplicable: No PowerSync Stream, local Project row/lifecycle projection, optimistic archive overlay, upload connector or synchronized visibility/readiness claim is defined.

items: The complete command is canonical Codable evidence over draft, shared envelope, exact expected-revision precondition, Project subject and fingerprint; decode reconstructs through the same validators and byte-identical structured restart is required.

Changed Account, actor, contract, Project payload, revision subject/value/count, command subject, fingerprint or receipt OperationID fails atomically without rebinding identity or converting archive into a generic toggle/delete.

A deterministic reference adapter may accept the command into the shared OperationJournal and prove exact replay/receipt semantics; this is not physical durable-store, process/device restart, optimistic archived-row, authoritative history-preservation or offline-authorization evidence.

storageMedia.notApplicable: ArchiveProject owns no attachment reference/bytes/retention behavior and cannot detach or delete Project hero media.

appMcp.notApplicable: No Project archive UI, current app service, MCP tool/schema, transport, contract-catalog entry or app/MCP parity claim is wired.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase Project/isArchived field, children, source export or archived-state migration is decoded or transformed. Later migration must reconcile lifecycle and every retained reference.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failures are contract values only; no signal emission, metric, alert, audit sink or runbook action is introduced.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and its tests and does not change or link either application project.

The slice cannot visibly or authoritatively archive/restore/delete a Project, preserve children in storage, authorize membership, choose Auth, alter Client/category/media/accounting state, define provider/schema/migration behavior, activate a feature, deploy, release or cut over.
O-024/O-025, A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016, physical offline verification, production profiling and O-022 remain outside this command boundary.

verification.expected: A valid synthetic draft produces one typed exact-scope ArchiveProject command with one same-subject expected revision and no Client/name/details/category/media/child/delete/restore/generic-write input.

Representative commands round-trip byte-identically with exact Account/actor/contract/Operation/Project/revision/time/subject/fingerprint evidence and no backend path, provider, credential, child/history result or delete claim.
Invalid time and changed Account/actor/contract/Project/revision subject/value/count/command subject/fingerprint/receipt evidence fail atomically through Project-archive stable diagnostic codes.

A deterministic reference port returns the shared queued receipt, exact replay returns the same receipt, same OperationID with changed Project/revision intent is refused by the shared lifecycle, and a failing port returns no success receipt.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming server, authorization, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 archive command only. D-006 requires Project archive to leave Client identity untouched. O-024 remains fully open because no physical delete/discard exists; O-025 remains open because no Client reassignment/merge exists. Restore/unarchive is deliberately absent pending its own exact command authority rather than a generic lifecycle toggle. The slice stops before physical durable storage, authoritative history preservation, server apply, schema/RLS/Sync/Auth/provider, app/MCP, source migration, hosted resources, production access or cutover.
